summary: The PR addresses the issue of using SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS for session authentication hashes but introduces a loop that may not behave as expected.

issues.description: The loop iterates over SECRET_KEY and SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS, but the condition `if auth_hash:` will always be true because `hexdigest()` returns a non-empty string. This means the loop will always return after the first iteration, effectively ignoring the fallback keys.
